title:
Transform to set the `hidden` property for the `System Triaged?` column on the CaseDetailAlertsTabGrid and CaseAlertsListModalGrid,
based on the {@link ReliabilityAlertTriagingConfiguration#automaticallyAddToCase} configuration value.
This transform is also used to set the `timeZone` property on the timestamp column.

Expects a json object as input with the following properties:
       columnFields {UiSdlDataGridDataSpecColumnFieldSetting[]} - Indicates where to locate grid data within the component.
       alertTriagingConfig {Boolean} - {@link ReliabilityAlertTriagingConfiguration#automaticallyAddToCase} configuration value.
       timeZone {String} - The time zone to use for the timestamp column.
name: ConfigurableSystemTriagedColumnTransform
